question: Where was the semicryogenic engine hot test held in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ISRO Propulsion Complex, Mahendragiri**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **semicryogenic engine** hot test was conducted successfully at the **ISRO Propulsion Complex (IPRC), Mahendragiri**, in April 2025.
 
• The test was a critical milestone in developing India’s **next-generation rocket engines** using eco-friendly and cost-effective propellants.
 
• The semicryogenic engine operates using **liquid oxygen (LOX) as the oxidizer** and refined kerosene (RP-1) as the fuel, making it efficient and powerful.
 
• The ISRO Propulsion Complex, located in Tamil Nadu, serves as a premier center for testing and assembling propulsion systems for India's space missions.
 
• This advancement aligns with ISRO's plans to enhance its launch vehicle capabilities for heavier payloads and interplanetary missions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vikram Sarabhai Space Centre (VSSC), Thiruvananthapuram:**

 
 
• VSSC is the main center for designing and developing launch vehicles for ISRO.
 
• It focuses on rocket development, including technologies for solid, liquid, and cryogenic propulsion systems.
 
 
 
• **Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC), Sriharikota:**
 
 
• SDSC is the primary launch site for ISRO's rockets and satellites.
 
• It hosts facilities for vehicle assembly, integration, and launch operations.
 
 
 
• **Down Range Station, Port Blair:**
 
 
• This facility monitors and tracks vehicles post-launch.
 
• It provides telemetry data from the launch vehicle during its flight.
